summary: Short residential kerb, homes 12-17 m away, with driveways close.

best_section.where: Thorpe Street south kerb, in front of the low-set house with the tiled roof

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 12-17 m away on both sides; none within 10 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street; a van fits at the kerb between driveways, though only just over one van length.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the street; no sign of van stays.

sun_shade: Open to the north; small trees shade the kerb side.
